Definition: Shobab, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shobab was a son of David, born to him in Jerusalem, named among his sons alongside Nathan and Solomon. The same name belongs to another man, a son of Caleb, but the Shobab of the royal line is the one the chroniclers list three times.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sons of David who never wore the crown still belong in the record. Shobab never ruled, and I hold that God keeps the names of the un-crowned sons too.
